name: Crystal Clarity
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: Maximum detail without harshness for acoustic, vocal and well-recorded music. Low-mid mud is trimmed, presence rises only when the 3 kHz region is quiet, and air is added by a harmonic exciter plus a 12 kHz shelf. A dynamic de-harsh band and a 7 kHz de-esser keep sibilance and cymbals smooth.
